questions: How must QuoteAPI behave on a screening outage? (Gap id: QuoteAPI|on_screening_outage, DECLARED GAP gap:declared:OD-1, proposed but unverified assertion A:llm:QuoteAPI|on_screening_outage@v1 cannot be used.)

When the status is a non-priced hold (e.g. review_hold), should the response include any explicit hold indicator field or only the status? (Key: response|hold_presence is UNKNOWN and must be specified.)
claims: Only knowledge with status approved or verified may be treated as fact; declared gaps and inferred/proposed items cannot be used as facts or silent assumptions. [policy]
On storage failure, no screening, pricing, or notification occurs and the status must be error: store_unavailable. [A:dt:QuoteAPI|on_store_failure@v1]
Notification is fire-and-forget; failures do not change the stored quote or the response. [A:dt:QuoteAPI|on_notification_failure@v1]
The end-to-end flow order is validate > store > screen > decide > price > notify > respond. [A:spec:flow|order@v1]
The response status values are constrained to quoted, review_hold, refused_screening, 'rejected: invalid_request', and 'error: store_unavailable'. [A:oas:response|statuses@v1]
The price field is present exactly on the priced rows of DT-S. [A:oas:response|price_presence@v1]
The quote_id field is present whenever a draft was stored. [A:spec:response|quote_id_presence@v1]
